title: Heavenly Inquisition Sword
description: Yeon Jeokha was born as the son of his father's second wife and suffered years of abuse from his stepmother and half-siblings. After his father dies, he is imprisoned in a warehouse and eventually manages to escape. He discovers a mysterious mirror containing a spirit who teaches him the powerful Nine Heavens Sword Art, a martial technique created by his father. After ten years of relentless training, Yeon Jeokha returns to the martial world as the sole successor of the Heavenly Inquisition Sword, determined to settle the grievances of his past.
author: Cardok / Jo Jin Young
